items.title: Should Hyatt Hotels (H) Stock Watchers Care About Its New Loyalty Partnership?
items.summary: Hyatt Hotels (NYSE:H) and Delta Air Lines announced a new joint loyalty collaboration that connects their programs for frequent travelers. The partnership allows members to link accounts and earn rewards across both brands, with broader benefits scheduled to begin in 2027. The collaboration introduces milestone rewards that span hotel stays and air travel, aiming to increase engagement across both loyalty platforms. items.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL) Faces Fuel Hedge Crunch As It Pushes ATC Upgrades
items.summary: Delta Air Lines (NYSE:DAL) is confronting higher fuel bills as older jet fuel hedge contracts expire in late 2026. US carriers are weighing whether to lock in current jet fuel prices through new hedges or stay exposed to future price swings. Delta CEO Ed Bastian is urging Washington to modernize US air traffic control systems, citing congestion and operational inefficiencies. These twin pressures of expiring fuel hedges and air traffic control reform debates should sit alongside other...
